articles.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
articles.description: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

articles.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
articles.description: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.

articles.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
articles.description: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

articles.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
articles.description: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

articles.title: Asian Cup postponed in wake of attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.description: The 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia is postponed because of a series of deadly attacks on the host country.

articles.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
articles.description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

articles.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
articles.description: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.

articles.title: US carries out 'limited strikes' on Qeshm Island in Iran
articles.description: The US military has carried out "limited strikes" on Qeshm Island in Iran - hours before the midterms are due to take place.

articles.title: 'Everything is destroyed': Hackers target refrigerators in new cyber attacks
articles.description: Cyber hackers have targeted fridges and freezers in supermarkets in several European countries including Ireland – causing temperatures to increase and food to spoil.
